name: v0.3.31 alternate payload before a repeated input
research_question: On a non-hub page, if a followup would repeat an input already used in the current branch, does switching to a different input text for that field keep Guard bugs and confirm the empty-title submit bug?
diagnosis: On creek budget 120 the candidate opened prefs, typed the normal title twice, and returned. The second input was on a new signature, so v0.3.30 did not treat it as a repeat. Guard came back to the original prefs signature, typed the empty title, and clicked submit, confirming BUG-CR4. The same loss is RG4, WF4, and KN4. The v0.3.30 rule did fire later, on hub navigation such as btn_internal and nav_help. BuggyDesk lost BUG-K10 and BuggyShop lost BUG-W6. The v0.3.30 module is not edited, and the rule is not allowed to take an arbitrary click.
not: an edit of the frozen v0.3.30 candidate
permission to take an arbitrary untried click
permission to change the product default
permission to retune after the fresh matrix

candidate.rule: Remember input keys used during the current branch. On a non-hub page, when the first followup repeats one of those keys, take another input for the same field with different text if the action list has one. Do not take a different click.

topology_rule: New positives keep the chart-to-prefs page. Submit, probe, and export stay on that prefs page. The score page stays on the roster hub.

outcomes.C: Guard loss on a fresh target, historical Guard loss, safety violation, negative handoff, candidate edit, or product-default change
outcomes.D: Safety holds but fewer than 3 positives are evaluable
outcomes.B: Guard bugs are kept and at least 3 positives are evaluable, but fewer than 3 keep every Guard bug, confirm the empty-title submit bug, and record an alternate-payload selection
outcomes.A: At least 3 positives keep every Guard bug, confirm the empty-title submit bug, and record an alternate-payload selection. Negatives have no nested handoff. The historical suite loses no Guard bug. The product default stays unchanged.
